newsitem.title: USA: Socket and Cetronic sign merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Socket and Cetronic sign merger pact.

text.p: Socket Communications Inc said Friday it had signed a definitive merger agreement with Cetronic AB, a venture-capital-backed company based in Sweden that develops and markets software and hardware for the wireless data communications markets.
Socket announced its intent to combine with Cetronic on May 7.

Socket said it will issue up to $11.7 million of common stock in a share swap with Cetronic. The number of Socket shares issued will be determined by dividing $11.7 million by 80 percent of the average market price of Socket common stock over a 20-day period prior to the expiration of the stock-swap offer.
A minimum of 5.2 million and a maximum of 15.6 million Socket shares will be issued to Cetronic shareholders in the merger, Socket said.
The purchase price in U.S. dollars will be adjusted for currency fluctuations between the dollar and the Swedish krona, Socket said.
